# Vedansh Harish Ail

> Software Engineer | Full Stack Development | Quality Engineering

Vedansh Harish Ail is a Software Engineer and MCA (Master of Computer Applications) graduate from St. Agnes College (Autonomous), Mangaluru, with hands-on experience in full-stack web development, backend engineering, RESTful API design, database architecture, and quality engineering.

## Summary & Positioning
- Professional Focus: Full Stack Software Engineering, Backend Architecture, Quality Engineering & Test Automation.
- Educational Credentials: MCA from St. Agnes College (Autonomous), Mangaluru (Completed, CGPA: 8.33); BCA from Dr. P.D.P. - P.S.P. Government First Grade College (Completed 2024, CGPA: 7.87).
- Key Strengths: Scalable web architecture, automated test pipelines, relational data modeling, API integration, and clean code principles.

## Core Technical Skills
- Programming Languages: Python, Java, JavaScript (ES6+), SQL
- Frontend Technologies: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
- Backend & APIs: Flask, FastAPI, REST APIs, JSON APIs, Authentication & RBAC
- Databases: PostgreSQL, SQLite
- Quality Engineering & Testing: Selenium WebDriver, Manual Testing, Automation Testing, Postman API Testing, Test Case Design
- DevOps & Developer Tools: Git, GitHub, Jenkins CI/CD, Jira Defect Tracking, VS Code, PyCharm
- Emerging & Web3: Solidity, Ethereum, Hardhat, Ethers.js

## Featured Projects
- [AgroChain](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/agrochain): Hybrid Web2/Web3 agricultural supply chain platform with Solidity smart contracts for crop traceability, decentralized ratings, and peer-to-peer microfinance. (React, Flask, Solidity, Ethers.js, Hardhat).
- [Meri Panchayat](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/meri-panchayat): Scalable public issue reporting portal for rural governance with secure Email OTP, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Kannada localization engine. (Flask, SQLite, Python, HTML/CSS).
- [Helio - Personal Document Vault](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/helio): Zero-knowledge encrypted personal document storage system featuring client-side cryptographic hashing, categorized record vaults, and verified access control. (Python, Flask, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Cryptography).
- [PrintFlow Agent](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/printflow): Intelligent workflow automation agent managing document spooling, SLA-based priority queue routing, preflight parsing, and printer hardware dispatch. (Python, REST APIs, Queue Orchestration).
- [Smart Recipe Generator](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/smart-recipe-generator): Responsive recipe recommendation platform utilizing the Spoonacular API with an offline-first fallback database of 60+ recipes. (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
- [Resume Builder](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/resume-builder): Privacy-first ATS resume generator with real-time dynamic preview, client-side PDF parsing via PDF.js, and instant Harvard template export. (HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript).
- [Wedding Invitation Platform](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/wedding-invitation): Bespoke digital wedding celebration platform featuring dynamic ceremony schedules, 1-click maps navigation, and real-time RSVP tracking. (React, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript).
- [News Scraper](https://vedansh-portfolio-beta.vercel.app/projects/news-scraper): Automated multi-source news aggregator and curation tool that extracts, categorizes, and summarizes headlines in real time. (Python, BeautifulSoup, Flask).
